studies.title: Diffusion
studies.line: One note scatters into thousands of echoes that blur into a cloud: what a reverb does in its first half-second.

options.name: Ink in water, slow
options.line: Slowed right down, and the back-and-forth is gone: the ink only ever moves forward. One full turn of the loop takes 40 s.

options.name: Ink in water, slower
options.line: The same, a third slower again: a full turn takes 60 s. Live, both drift gently upward and never repeat.

studies.title: Waves
studies.line: Sound as rings of pressure moving out through the room, losing their edge as they go.

options.name: Ripples, diffusing
options.line: Crisp rings near the source; further out they widen, wobble, break into fragments and finally scatter into loose points of light.

options.name: Contour lines, dissolving
options.line: Thin lines lifted by a slow swell: crisp at the left, and toward the right they widen, fray and fall apart.

studies.title: Haze
studies.line: The late tail, where the echoes are too dense to hear apart and turn into one soft wash.

options.name: Moon behind cloud
options.line: The cloud is now lit across the whole sky, with a brighter rim where it thins; the glow itself is held down so text stays readable.

options.name: Moon behind cloud, brighter
options.line: One step brighter: the brightest version whose brightest pixel still keeps secondary text above 4.5:1 in the hero.

options.name: Ground mist
options.line: Denser banks with clearer gaps between them, so the layers read as mist rather than a tint.

options.name: Ground mist, brighter
options.line: One step brighter: the brightest version that still keeps secondary text above 4.5:1 in the hero.
